spans.s: भञ्ज् (ओ, औ) ओभञ्जौ r. 7th cl. (भनक्ति) To break, to destroy.

भञ्जक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what breaks, severes, divides, destroys,
&c.
 E. भञ्ज् to break, ण्वुल aff.

भञ्जत् mfn. (-ञ्जन्-ञ्जन्ती-ञ्जत) Breaking, destroying
 E. भञ्ज्, and शतृ aff.

. Removing.
 m. (-नः) Decay
of teeth.
 E. भञ्ज to break, ल्युट् aff.

भञ्जनक m. (-कः) A disease of the mouth, contortion of the lips, and
decay of the teeth.
 E. भञ्जन, and कन् added.

भञ्जरु m. (-रुः) A tree growing near a temple.
 E. भञ्ज to break, उरु aff.
